app.tagline: Free AI models. Zero setup. May the best model win.
c.confirm: Are you sure? This cannot be undone.
settings.title: Settings
settings.forceLang: Force AI to answer in this language
settings.systemPromptPh: e.g. You are a concise expert assistant…
settings.apiKeysDesc: ModelClash works with no keys. Add a key only to unlock premium models. Keys stay on this device.
settings.customModelsDesc: One per line, format: provider/model-id (providers: pollinations, openrouter, groq, gemini)
settings.webllmDesc: Run models fully offline in your browser. Nothing leaves your device.
settings.noWebGPU: WebGPU is not available in this browser. Try Chrome or Edge.
settings.clearDataDesc: Chats, battles, gallery, saved prompts and ELO ratings.
chat.title: Direct Chat
chat.emptySub: Free models, no login, no keys. Just type.
ex.code: Explain closures in JavaScript with one tiny example
ex.idea: 10 unexpected weekend projects with local AI
ex.learn: Teach me game theory basics in 5 bullet points
battle.title: Blind Battle
battle.desc: Two anonymous models answer the same prompt. Vote for the better answer — only then are the names revealed.
tourn.title: Tournament
tourn.desc: Single-elimination bracket. Same prompt for every match. Vote your way to a champion — finals count double ELO.
image.title: Image Arena
image.desc: Two AI engines draw the same idea. Free, no keys. Vote for the better picture.
lb.title: Leaderboard
lb.desc: ELO ratings built only from your own battles. K=32, everyone starts at 1200.
lb.noData: No battles yet — go start one!
compare.title: Compare
compare.desc: Run one prompt through up to 4 models side by side, then continue the conversation with your favorite.
compare.pickWinner: Click the winning answer to continue with it
prompts.title: Prompt Library
prompts.desc: Tap to use. Yours are saved on this device.
prompts.addPh: Paste or write a prompt to save…
p.write: Write a 300-word short story with a twist ending about a lighthouse keeper who receives letters from the future.
p.code:
Review the following code. Point out bugs, style issues and performance problems, then show an improved version:

```
// paste your code here
```
p.learn: Explain quantum entanglement like I'm 12, then give me a 3-question quiz to check my understanding.
p.debate: Steel-man both sides of: “social media does more harm than good”. Then give your honest verdict in 2 sentences.
p.brainstorm: Give me 10 unexpected ideas for a weekend project, ranked from safest to wildest. One line each.
p.roleplay: You are a sarcastic medieval blacksmith. Stay in character no matter what I ask. Greet me.
err.busy: Free tier is busy — retrying in 5 s…
err.key: API key invalid or missing — re-enter it in Settings.
err.server: Model is busy right now. Try again or switch model.
err.network: Network error — check your connection and try again.
err.timeout: Took too long. Try a shorter prompt or another model.
err.stream: The stream broke mid-answer. Retried without streaming.
err.local: Local model failed. Try a smaller model.
install.title: Install ModelClash
install.desc: Works offline, opens from your home screen, zero clutter.
install.ios: On iPhone: tap Share → “Add to Home Screen”.
voice.unsupported: Voice input is not supported in this browser.
image.needGemini: Add a free Gemini API key in Settings to unlock Imagen 4 & Nano Banana.
err.credits: Your key is valid, but this model needs paid credits — top up your account or pick a FREE model.
err.forbidden: The provider refused this request (region or content restriction) — try another model.
settings.keyBad: Invalid key — check it and paste again
